<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
f=current_frame; rows=f.ascii.split('\n')
print("dot colors:", rows[22][13], rows[30][14], rows[30][17], rows[28][13], rows[46][10], rows[46][19], rows[46][37], rows[46][40], rows[46][43])
def pat(r0,r1,c0,c1,cols):
    return frozenset((r-r0,cc-c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1) if rows[r][cc] in cols)
def rot(p): return frozenset((c,-r) for r,c in p)
def norm(p):
    mr=min(r for r,c in p); mc=min(c for r,c in p); return frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in p)
def rots(p):
    out=set()
    for _ in range(4): out.add(norm(p)); p=rot(p)
    return out
BL=pat(21,32,12,23,'BWbS'); BR=pat(27,32,45,56,'BWbS')
Yt=pat(3,14,33,44,'YWbS'); Yb=pat(42,53,33,44,'YWbS'); YLt=pat(9,14,9,20,'YWbS'); Yl=pat(42,47,9,20,'YWbS')
print("sizes",len(BL),len(BR),len(Yt),len(Yb),len(YLt),len(Yl))
for a,an in [(BL,'BL'),(BR,'BR')]:
    ra=rots(a)
    for b,bn in [(Yt,'Yt'),(Yb,'Yb'),(YLt,'YLt'),(Yl,'Yl')]:
        if len(a)==len(b):
            print(an,bn,"MATCH" if norm(b) in ra else "symdiff %d"%min(len(x^norm(b)) for x in ra))
print("B before:",[(n['pixels'],min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='B' and n['pixels']>20])
action(['SPACE'])
print("after SPACE:",[(n['color'],n['pixels'],min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['pixels']>20 and n['color'] not in ('b',)])
action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT:",[(n['color'],n['pixels'],min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['pixels']>20 and n['color'] not in ('b',)])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
